title: Sapphire TriXX Won't Install
fullDescription: TriXX requires AMD Adrenalin to be present. Install Adrenalin first, then TriXX.

faq.a: No, Adrenalin can OC; TriXX adds boost mode.

title: NITRO Fan Stops Spinning
shortDescription: Quick connect fan loose or fails.
fullDescription: NITRO+ fans are removable; if not seated, they won't spin. Reseat or replace.

fixSteps.title: Reseat fan module
fixSteps.instruction: Remove screws, lift fan, replace firmly.

fixSteps.title: Order replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Sapphire sells Quick Connect fans separately.

title: Pulse Coil Whine in Menus
shortDescription: High pitched buzz at high FPS.
fullDescription: Cap framerate; consider RMA if extreme.

fixSteps.title: Enable AMD Chill
fixSteps.instruction: Adrenalin > Tuning > Chill, set min/max to refresh.

title: TOXIC BIOS Switch Position Wrong
fullDescription: Switch reads only after full power cycle. Hold power 10s.

fixSteps.title: Full off and toggle
fixSteps.instruction: Shut down PSU, flip switch, restart.

title: TOXIC AIO Pump Stalls
fullDescription: Pump may stall after long off-time. Restart PC; if no recovery, RMA.

title: AMD Software Error 182
shortDescription: Unable to detect compatible AMD graphics hardware.
fullDescription: Adrenalin Error 182 occurs when driver doesn't match the GPU. Use AMD Auto-Detect tool.

fixSteps.title: Use Auto Detect
fixSteps.instruction: Download from amd.com/support, run as admin.

faq.a: Disable iGPU in BIOS if Adrenalin keeps loading wrong package.

title: Sapphire AMD Random Black Screen
fullDescription: Common AMD black screen issue; mitigate with MPT power tweaks or driver downgrade.

fixSteps.title: Try older WHQL driver
fixSteps.instruction: Roll back to last stable Adrenalin.

title: Memory Overclock Causes Crashes
fullDescription: VRAM OC adds errors silently; AMD's error correction masks but eventually drops perf.

title: BSOD amdkmdag.sys
fullDescription: AMD kernel mode driver fault. Disable MPO, update Adrenalin, or reset overclocks.

title: ARGB Sync Cable Doesn't Detect
fullDescription: NITRO+ ships ARGB cable; verify polarity and 5V (not 12V) header.
